subject: The mistake 87% of new users make on Day 3
preview_text: It's why their dogs aren't losing weight yet. Here's what the successful 13% did differently today.
body_paragraphs: I just checked the numbers. 87 new users logged in today and did the exact same thing. They looked at their dog's profile, maybe poked around, and closed the app. Meanwhile, 13 users did something different. Their dogs are already on track to hit their first weight milestone next week.

Those 13 people didn't just look. They used the Calorie Calculator for their dog's dinner tonight. They discovered the exact portion size their specific dog needs. No guesswork. No 'is this too much?' anxiety. Just the truth, in grams. That's the secret hack the vets don't have time to explain in a 15-minute visit.

The feature is right there on your home screen. 'Calculate My Dog's Meal.' It takes 60 seconds. You tell it what you're feeding (kibble, wet food, homemade), and it gives you the perfect portion based on your dog's unique weight loss goal. No more confusing bag instructions meant for 'average' dogs.

Open the app right now and calculate tonight's dinner. Don't let your pup be in the 87%. Be in the 13% who are already seeing changes. Your best friend is waiting. P.S. The dogs of those 13 users? They're already sleeping better and have more energy for play. That starts with the right dinner tonight.
